title: Act: Add BootScene.preload driven by planPreload
description: Bundle manifest.json into runtime/content.ts, validate with parseManifest, and add BootScene.preload that loads planned ids.
acceptance_criteria: preload calls this.load.image(id, 'assets/'+path) only for planned image ids
unknown ids are warned, not loaded

steps.action: Import manifest.json from public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room and export `manifest` as the data of parseManifest(json); throw an Error listing errors when ok is false.

Add preload(): compute plan = planPreload(scene, manifest); console.warn for each plan.unknown id; for each id in plan.load find the manifest entry and call this.load.image(entry.id, `assets/${entry.path}`) when entry.type is 'image'; skip other types.
